agenteDeMaquina.verificando: Checking whether your account already has a paired machine…
agenteDeMaquina.semPapel: Device keys belong to each person, and listing yours needs the developer role on this project — so this screen did not check whether you already have a paired machine.
agenteDeMaquina.naoSei: I could not check whether your account already has a paired machine. That does not mean it has none — it means I do not know.
agenteDeMaquina.pareada: Your account already has a paired machine: {{nomes}}. A local agent last used that key on {{data}}.
agenteDeMaquina.pareadaNuncaUsada: Your account already has a paired machine: {{nomes}} — and no local agent has used that key yet.
agenteDeMaquina.revogada: This account's machine key ({{nomes}}) is revoked: no local agent connects with it. Pair again below.
agenteDeMaquina.ressalvaNaoEBatimento: A registered key is not a running agent: it proves the machine was paired once, never that the agent is up right now.
agenteDeMaquina.ressalvaDaConta: This list belongs to your ACCOUNT, not to this browser: if you are on another machine, that one still needs pairing.
agenteDeMaquina.alcance: A machine key serves every project of yours in runner mode — revoking it takes the local agent down in all of them.
agenteDeMaquina.gesto: On the paired machine, check the local agent's service:
